explication: LiquidBounce is a Fabric-based Minecraft client that injects runtime changes into the game and provides a Svelte theme for interacting with client features. The main user flow is configuring features through the in-game interface, applying them during gameplay, and rendering their results in the HUD or world. Other visible capabilities include account management, multiplayer and proxy screens, cosmetics, and note-bot and deep-learning support. The graph combines documented product scope with sampled source; connections for unsampled subsystems are intentionally limited.
